historical_references.reference: Ajinkya was a Maratha general and a strong commander in the army of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the founder of the Maratha Empire in India. He played a significant role in the Battle of Pratapgarh (1659) in which Shivaji was able to establish his de facto independence from the Mughal Empire.
